name: codedp-bench-seq-extraction-cpt-p100
description: This benchmark measures models' ability to perform sequence extraction tasks in code-related contexts — extracting or identifying correct code sequences/snippets given inputs (e.g., docstrings, examples or noisy code). It is intended to evaluate code-understanding and information-extraction capabilities of code models, including exactness of extracted sequences. Tasks typically require precise token-level matching and robust parsing of programming constructs.
reputation: A niche benchmark hosted on Hugging Face for code extraction tasks with limited community adoption compared to larger code benchmarks.
